description: A genomic feature (gene, transcript, exon, or genomic interval) used as a quantified row in RNA-seq expression matrices and/or as an annotated feature related to a genomic variant.

featureIdentifier.description: Identifier of the genomic feature as it appears in the expression matrix (native accession), plus the identifier namespace. Gene symbols MUST NOT be stored here; use aliases instead. Annotation release (e.g. Ensembl 109) belongs on the matrix annotation, not on this object.

id.description: Native accession of the genomic feature as used in the matrix row (versioned when the matrix uses versioned IDs). Not a CURIE. For anonymous or interval-derived features with no public accession, a locally minted identifier MUST be used.

resource.description: Identifier namespace for id. An identifiers.org prefix is recommended (e.g. ensembl, hgnc, ncbigene, refseq, gencode). Use local for locally minted identifiers. Required because id is not a CURIE.

genomicInterval.description: Genomic interval of the genomic feature, uses the VRS schema for the coordinates and adds the strand

aliases.description: Human-readable names or symbols commonly used for this feature (gene symbols, transcript names, or other aliases).

xrefs.description: Cross-references of the genomic feature. CURIE format is recommended.

featureType.description: Ontology term that describes the type of genomic feature. Values from SO (Sequence Ontology) are recommended.

ontologyTerms.description: Ontology terms of the genomic feature like biological functions, molecular effects, etc.

relationship.description: Hierarchical relationships of the genomic feature (gene -> transcript -> exon). parent and children MUST use the same native id form as featureIdentifier.id (not CURIEs).

parent.description: Parent of the genomic feature, usually a gene or transcript. Value MUST match the parent's featureIdentifier.id.

children.description: Children of the genomic feature, usually a transcript or exon. Values MUST match each child's featureIdentifier.id.

title: GenomicFeature
